description: A floor-length deep teal Khuzait robe-dress in substantial woven fabric, patterned with gold scrolling and animal motifs. The wrapped high collar and overlapping front have broad gold embroidered borders, with loose wrist-length sleeves, decorated cuffs and a wide brown leather and gold medallion belt. A long ornamental tassel and small bead ornaments hang from the belt. A layered skirt and dark embroidered shoes complete the modest everyday noble outfit.
